parse_tao_bench_output: parse TAO bench stdout to extract server and client QPS metrics and hit rates
create_server_snapshot: create a TaoBenchServerSnapshot from a fast_qps log line to parse key performance metrics
generate_server_csv: generate a CSV file of server snapshots with QPS, hit rate, and OOM columns
process_server_snapshots: process server snapshots to calculate average fast and slow QPS with hit rate filtering
get_snapshot_metric: get a specific metric value from a TaoBenchServerSnapshot using the get method
